resources.string: Keep the conversation going. Your desktop does the work, wherever you are.
Connect Tailscale on both devices, then open Connect phone in your desktop app.
Remove this desktop and its saved login from this phone? You can also revoke the phone in MuseCode on your desktop.
Enter the private address from MuseCode. Use the full QR link to pair a new phone.
Use a MuseCode HTTPS link ending in .ts.net:8443. Scan a fresh QR code from your desktop to pair.
Scan the QR in MuseCode → Connect phone
Camera access is needed to scan a QR code. You can also enter the desktop link.
Your desktop is out of reach.
Connect Tailscale on this phone and keep your desktop awake with MuseCode running. Then try again.
The desktop certificate could not be verified. Check the date on both devices and your Tailscale HTTPS setup.
This closes your current phone conversation. The work on your desktop keeps running.
No browser is available to open this link.
